matrix_metadata.scope: termux-packages core and runtime-critical subset (50 key packages selected from 2059+ inventory)
matrix_metadata.relationship_model: 7-direction sociratic humility (provision, dependency, conflict, implementation, evidence, falsification, evolutionary)
matrix_metadata.production_gate: Source analysis only; build/runtime verification TOKEN_VAZIO

1_provision.semantic: The abstractions or services this package exports to dependents
examples: apt → Debian package manager CLI interface

2_dependency.direction: DEPENDENCY (What does this require from others?)
2_dependency.semantic: Declared and implied dependencies on other packages
examples: libcurl → requires libssl, libz, libnghttp2, libnghttp3, libngtcp2

3_conflict.semantic: Incompatibilities or mutual exclusions with other packages

4_implementation.semantic: Contracts/standards/ABIs that this package adheres to
examples: curl/libcurl implement libcurl API and HTTP RFCs

5_evidence.semantic: Build artifacts, test results, and observable proofs
examples: ELF header validation proves linkable object
test suite output proves functional correctness (when executed)

6_falsification.semantic: Negative evidence, failing tests, or contradictory declarations
examples: declared_static: true but uses dlopen() → contradiction
architecture: arm64 but contains arm32-only binaries → falsifier

7_evolutionary.semantic: Version history, migration paths, and supersession

3_conflict.note: bash coexists with other shells (dash, sh, zsh) via alternatives

7_evolutionary.migration_note: bash-5 recommended for POSIX compliance; backward compat issues with bash-4 scripts documented
